title: Tesseract prompt-to-edit demo (speed ramp + wipe compare)
summary: An 11 s square demo of an AI video-editing agent. A full-bleed AI clip (man kicking a suitcase, belongings frozen mid-air) plays, speed-ramps into hyper slow motion as it shrinks into a rounded card above a chat prompt box; a second prompt types 'add some subtle grain, noise, and turbulent displacement' and a vertical wipe line sweeps across to reveal the result. Minimal, dark, 'type it and it happens'.
fit_reason: The 'prompt box under a media card, type the instruction, see it applied with a wipe compare' layout is a strong template for showing SaaSSuite automations, but the AI-footage subject itself is off-brand.

palette.mood: neutral dark studio, content provides colour

typography.display: small system sans (Inter/SF) inside a chat composer
typography.size_behaviour: small caption-size prompt text, no headlines
typography.notes: Composer shows app badge 'Tesseract', placeholder 'Approve for me', model picker 'GPT-6 Astra Ultra' with purple 'Ultra', mic and round blue send button.

prompt replaced by clearing then retyping

subtle continuous push-in on the media
transitions: scale-down from full-bleed into UI card
vertical 1px white wipe line sweeping left to right for before/after (9.0-9.6 s)

Second prompt types, then a vertical wipe line reveals the grain/displacement result

recreate.how: Remotion or ffmpeg + HTML overlay: scale video layer into a rounded clip-path card, composer as HTML with typewriter, speed ramp via setpts on the source clip, wipe as two stacked videos with an animated clip-path inset.
recreate.prompt: Square #1e1e1e canvas; full-bleed clip shrinks into a rounded card with a white chat composer beneath; an instruction types out with a caret, the footage changes in response (slow-mo), then a thin white vertical line wipes across to compare before/after. Calm, single shot.
